parks: Villa Borghese, Rome, Italy
Villa Borghese is a big public park.
博尔盖塞别墅公园是一座大型的公共公园。
There are beautiful gardens, trees and some fountains, too.
那里还有漂亮的花园、树木和一些喷泉。
People also call it ‘the park of museums’ because there are many interesting museums there.
人们也把它叫作“博物馆公园”，因为那里有许多有趣的博物馆。
Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, US
Everyone knows the Golden Gate Bridge, but did you know that there is a Golden Gate Park in San Francisco, too?
大家都知道金门大桥，但你知道旧金山也有一座金门公园吗？
It’s very big (4.8km long, almost 1km wide) and at one end you can see the sea.
它非常大（长4.8公里，宽将近1公里），在公园的一端可以看到大海。
Chapultepec Park, Mexico City, Mexico
Chapultepec Park is an important green space in this big city.
查普尔特佩克公园是这座大城市里一片重要的绿地。
It has a lake and a hill with a castle on it.
公园里有一个湖和一座小山，山上有一座城堡。
People in Mexico City love going there.
墨西哥城的人们很喜欢去那里。
El Parque del Buen Retiro, Madrid, Spain
In Madrid there is a very big park called Buen Retiro.
马德里有一座很大的公园，叫作丽池公园。
There are trees and paths and a lovely rose garden, too.
那里有树木、小路，还有一个漂亮的玫瑰园。
There is also a beautiful glass palace.
那里还有一座漂亮的玻璃宫殿。
The Iguana Park, Guayaquil, Ecuador
The park’s real name is Parque Seminario, but everyone calls it the Iguana Park because it is full of iguanas.
这座公园的正式名称是塞米纳里奥公园，但大家都叫它“鬣蜥公园”，因为那里到处都是鬣蜥。
The iguanas are very friendly.
这些鬣蜥很友好。
People go there and feed them.
人们会去那里给它们喂食。
Mount Faber Park, Singapore
On a mountain near Singapore, there is a park called Mount Faber.
在新加坡附近的一座山上，有一个叫花柏山公园的地方。
You can get there by cable car.
你可以坐缆车到那里。
In the park you can walk on a long path, or on an amazing bridge.
在公园里，你可以沿着一条长长的小路走，也可以走上一座令人惊叹的桥。
You get a great view of the city.
在那里可以欣赏到美丽的城市景色。
